metrics.new_entity_threshold: prefer records not already present in the corpus
metrics.corroboration_threshold: do not publish a third-party place as editorial fact without an independent source
metrics.state_staleness: flag operating-status claims older than 30 days when no current source exists
metrics.community_signal_rule: community reports remain signals unless independently corroborated
metrics.event_rule: event performance figures are dated observations, never permanent attributes

findings.finding: Current reporting says the Gyan Bhawan event runs Sep 20-29, 2026, with 135+ stalls from 15 states and reported business above Rs 68.56 lakh in its first three days.
Magicpin currently labels the outlet as shut down while retaining historical menu/review material.
A Patna Reddit discussion from Mar 31, 2026 describes Freshbox as a closed cloud kitchen and records repeated positive nostalgia for its food.
Bihar Foundation's cuisine archive explicitly documents Khoye-ki-Laai from Barh in Patna district and Chandrakala among traditional Bihar foods, supporting a district-level culinary geography layer.
Current food-discovery product positioning is moving toward craving-language, taste attributes, dish-level matching, photo input and personalization rather than restaurant directory browsing.

contradictions.issue: sales and attendance figures vary by reporting window
contradictions.resolution: retain dated observations; do not collapse to a single event total

contradictions.issue: listing retains an 'Open now' label while also saying 'outlet has shutdown'
contradictions.resolution: treat shutdown wording as a contradiction requiring current verification
